answer: Persistent Edge Routing. Each agent identity must sit at the center of a stable spiral of repeatedly reused counterparties; newcomers with no prior edges are quarantined to low-value tasks. An atlas of historical interaction graphs is maintained, and a bridge node connecting two previously disjoint clusters triggers mandatory re-verification of every edge on the path. Sybils therefore pay to fabricate and sustain convincing edge history across many accounts, a cost scaling with cluster size rather than a one-time fee.
